landing_trust_3_d: The delivery time is agreed up front and written in the quote.
landing_trust_4_d: A support period after launch is part of the quote, so you are not left alone on day one.

offer_ai_landing_title: AI-built landing page in days · OMNI101
offer_ai_landing_description: A focused, fast landing page for your business, designed and built with AI in days, not months. Start with a free personalized mini-demo.
offer_ai_landing_tagline: A landing page that is live in days, not months.
offer_ai_landing_what: One focused page that says what you do, to whom, and what to do next. We design and build it with AI-assisted tooling, then a human checks every line before it goes live.
offer_ai_landing_get_1: A single, fast, mobile-first page with your offer, proof and one clear call to action
offer_ai_landing_get_2: Copy written in plain English for your customers, not for search engines
offer_ai_landing_get_3: Contact form wired to your inbox, plus the basics of on-page SEO
offer_ai_landing_get_4: Source code and hosting setup handed over, so the page is yours
offer_ai_landing_step_1_d: Send your site or a few lines about what you sell and who buys it.
offer_ai_landing_step_2_d: We build a personalized first draft so you judge the real thing, not a pitch deck.
offer_ai_landing_step_3_d: You get a fixed quote. If you say yes, we refine the page and put it live.
offer_ai_landing_need_1: A link to your current site, or a short description of your business
offer_ai_landing_need_2: Your logo and any brand colors, if you have them
offer_ai_landing_need_3: One person who can approve copy and design quickly
offer_ai_landing_faq_1_q: Is a page built with AI generic?
offer_ai_landing_faq_1_a: It can be, if nobody steers it. We start from your offer and audience, and a designer reviews layout, copy and details. The mini-demo lets you check this before spending anything.
offer_ai_landing_faq_2_q: What happens after the free mini-demo?
offer_ai_landing_faq_2_a: You receive a fixed quote. There is no obligation, and the demo is yours to look at either way.
offer_ai_landing_faq_3_a: Yes. You get the code and the hosting setup, so you are not locked in to us.
offer_ai_landing_faq_4_a: Yes. Changes are quoted the same way as the first build, before any work starts.
offer_ai_landing_proof_1_note: Studio concept: a working-in-public site for a design practice.
offer_ai_landing_proof_2_note: Studio concept: direct-booking site for a small hotel.
offer_ai_assistant_title: AI assistant for your website · OMNI101
offer_ai_assistant_description: An assistant on your website that answers visitors and collects their requests for you. Start with a free personalized mini-demo.
offer_ai_assistant_tagline: An assistant that answers visitors and collects their requests.
offer_ai_assistant_what: A chat assistant on your site that answers common questions from your own content and, when someone is ready, collects their details and request for you to follow up.
offer_ai_assistant_get_1: An assistant trained on your services, hours, policies and FAQs
offer_ai_assistant_get_2: Requests delivered to you with the visitor’s contact details and what they asked
offer_ai_assistant_get_3: A clear hand-off: it says when a human needs to take over
offer_ai_assistant_get_4: A tone that matches your brand, and a way for you to update what it knows
offer_ai_assistant_step_1_d: Send your site and the questions you answer again and again.
offer_ai_assistant_step_2_d: The mini-demo is an assistant that already knows your business, so you can test it yourself.
offer_ai_assistant_step_3_d: You get a fixed quote. If you say yes, we connect it to your site and your inbox.
offer_ai_assistant_need_1: Your website or documents with the answers visitors need
offer_ai_assistant_need_2: The questions you most often get asked
offer_ai_assistant_need_3: Where requests should be sent (usually an email address)
offer_ai_assistant_faq_1_a: It is set up to answer from the content you provide and to say so when it does not know. We test it on your real questions during the demo.
offer_ai_assistant_faq_2_a: The assistant asks for consent before collecting contact details, and we explain what is stored and where before you go live.
offer_ai_assistant_faq_3_q: Does it replace me or my team?
offer_ai_assistant_faq_3_a: No. It handles repetitive questions and passes real requests to you with the context attached.
offer_ai_assistant_faq_4_q: Can I change what it says?
offer_ai_assistant_faq_4_a: Yes. Its knowledge comes from content you control, and updates are part of the quote.
offer_ai_assistant_proof_1_note: A live demo you can try on this site.
offer_ai_assistant_proof_2_note: A live demo you can try on this site.
offer_ai_automation_title: AI automation of a repetitive process · OMNI101
offer_ai_automation_description: We automate one repetitive task in your business, from request to result. Start with a free personalized mini-demo.
offer_ai_automation_tagline: Take one repetitive task off your plate.
offer_ai_automation_what: We pick one process that eats your time, such as sorting enquiries, sending quotes or updating a spreadsheet, and automate it end to end with a human check where it matters.
offer_ai_automation_get_1: One process automated from trigger to result, not a pile of loose tools
offer_ai_automation_get_2: A review step where you want a person to approve before anything is sent
offer_ai_automation_get_3: A short written description of how it works and what to do if it stops
offer_ai_automation_step_1_d: Tell us what you do by hand today, how often, and with which tools.
offer_ai_automation_step_2_d: The mini-demo shows your process automated on sample data, so you can judge the result.
offer_ai_automation_step_3_d: You get a fixed quote. If you say yes, we connect it to your real tools and watch the first runs.
offer_ai_automation_need_1: A description of the process and the tools involved
offer_ai_automation_need_2: A few real examples, with sensitive details removed
offer_ai_automation_need_3: Access to the tools, only once you decide to go ahead
offer_ai_automation_faq_1_q: Is my process too small to automate?
offer_ai_automation_faq_1_a: Often the small, boring ones pay off first. The mini-demo shows whether it is worth it before you commit.
offer_ai_automation_faq_2_q: What if it makes a mistake?
offer_ai_automation_faq_2_a: We add a review step wherever a mistake would cost you, and describe what the automation does so you can check it.
offer_ai_automation_faq_3_q: Do I need to give you access to my accounts?
offer_ai_automation_faq_3_a: Not for the mini-demo, which uses sample data. Access is only needed if you go ahead, and only to the tools involved.
offer_ai_automation_faq_4_q: Will I depend on you forever?
offer_ai_automation_faq_4_a: No. You get the configuration and a written description, so another person can maintain it.
offer_ai_automation_proof_1_note: A live demo you can try on this site.
offer_ai_automation_proof_2_note: Studio concept: connected intelligence across steps.
offer_ai_automation_proof_3_note: Studio concept: a restaurant’s operations, connected.

offer_local_desk_title: Local Desk for one location · OMNI101
offer_local_desk_description: One booking page for a home service, dental practice, consumer law firm, or medspa, plus review drafts a person sends. Start with a free snapshot of your public card.
offer_local_desk_tagline: One page. One way to request a time. A person sends the replies.
offer_local_desk_what: Local Desk is one booking page and a small reply desk for one location. The page says what you do, who it is for, and how to request a time. We draft replies to public reviews and answers to booking questions from facts you approve. A person sends every reply. An optional third part works on your public text. It is not a promise of placement, traffic, or mentions.
offer_local_desk_get_1: One booking page for one location: your offer, who it is for, and one way to request a time
offer_local_desk_get_2: Draft replies to public reviews, written only from facts you approve
offer_local_desk_get_3: Draft answers to booking questions, from those same facts. A person sends each reply
offer_local_desk_get_4: Optional work on your public text. No promise of placement, traffic, stars, or mentions
offer_local_desk_step_1_d: Send your page, or a few lines on what you do and who it is for.
offer_local_desk_step_2_d: A free look at your page, the request path, and whether reviews have a reply. It reads public text today. It is not a ranking.
offer_local_desk_step_3_d: If you continue, the quote states the scope and the schedule. No paid work starts before that.
offer_local_desk_need_1: Your current page, or a short description of the business
offer_local_desk_need_2: The facts we may use, and one person who can approve them
offer_local_desk_need_3: The inbox a person will use to send review replies and booking answers
offer_local_desk_faq_1_q: Will this bring bookings, stars, or traffic?
offer_local_desk_faq_1_a: No. We do not promise bookings, star ratings, traffic, or mentions in public answer tools. The page offers one way to request a time.
offer_local_desk_faq_2_a: A person does. We prepare the draft. Nothing is posted on its own.
offer_local_desk_faq_3_q: Do you give legal or medical advice?
offer_local_desk_faq_3_a: No. We do not advise as a lawyer or a clinician. You approve the facts first. We also do not answer the phone.
offer_local_desk_faq_4_a: Ads, a blog, a shop, extra languages, extra pages, a second location, a customer database, and phone answering.
